newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bids seen 7.55-7.65 pct at Portugal bond auction.
newsitem.headline: Bids seen 7.55-7.65 pct at Portugal bond auction.

text.p: Bids at today's auction of 10-year Portuguese Treasury bonds are expected to be between 7.55 and 7.65 percent, slightly above secondary market levels, dealers said.
Results of the auction of 20 billion escudos of the fixed rate bonds are due at around 1000 GMT.
"The auction is not expected to be aggressive," one fixed rate director said. "Bids should be between 7.55 and 7.65 percent, slightly above the secondary market level."
At the last auction on October 1, the Treasury placed 10 billion escudos of February 2006 bonds at 7.87 percent.
February 2006 bonds closed yesterday on the Continuous Market at 11,270 escudos to yield 7.54 percent with a spread of 25 basis points below January 2006 Bonos.
